svg.title: Tarankan Exim — Continuous Quality Inspection Journey
svg.desc: A seamless forward quality inspection journey. The camera travels upward from Specification Verification to Pre-Dispatch Inspection. Only three to four checkpoints are in view, and the route is visibly drawn behind the moving arrow as it advances.
